name: Grilled pork skewers
summary: Thick chunks of locally raised pork, from pigs fed a natural diet, are grilled on skewers. Eat them with rice or with a beer.
origin: Mang Den town and its village homestays.
howToEat: Eat the skewers with rice or beer, in the evening.
At the cultural night, thịt xiên comes with cơm lam, grilled chicken, bánh nếp, and rượu cần.
where: Mang Den town and village homestays.
The cultural night at Không gian văn hóa “Thiên đường Tây Nguyên- Măng Đen”, held after a race opening on the afternoon of 6 January.
seoTitle: Grilled pork skewers in Mang Den — thịt xiên
seoDescription: Thick chunks of locally raised pork grilled on skewers, eaten with rice or beer in Mang Den.
